gameInfo.title: Goblin Slayer — Persistent Goblin Sandbox
lossConditions: Nest completely destroyed with no survivors or escape

player.name: Unnamed
player.description: An ordinary adult male goblin of average size and strength for his kind. Wiry green skin, sharp yellow eyes, pointed ears, and the typical opportunistic instincts of a goblin. No special abilities, no remarkable equipment, no renown.

stats.notes: Ordinary goblin vitality. Comparable to a human child in raw strength, but agile and possessed of keen senses of smell and hearing.

inventory.name: Crude Club
inventory.description: A roughly shaped length of hard wood weighted with a knobby end. Barely better than a heavy stick.

inventory.name: Tattered Loincloth
inventory.description: A filthy scrap of cloth and leather scraps tied around the waist.

knowledge: The layout of the home nest
Basic goblin hierarchy and survival instincts
That humans and adventurers are extremely dangerous

grak-split-ear.notes: Nest leader. Stronger and meaner. Best not to draw his attention.

Nest Main Cavern.name: Nest Main Cavern
Nest Main Cavern.description: The central living space of a small goblin nest under a wooded hillside. Damp stone, low ceiling in places, a crude fire pit, scavenged furs and bones, and the constant smell of unwashed goblin bodies and old meat. Dim light filters from the entrance tunnel.

Nest Entrance Tunnel.name: Nest Entrance Tunnel
Nest Entrance Tunnel.description: A sloping, root-choked passage that leads from the main cavern up to a brush-hidden opening on the hillside. Defensible but not fortified.

Wooded Hillside.name: Wooded Hillside
Wooded Hillside.description: Dense mixed forest covering a low ridge. The nest entrance is well-concealed among roots and undergrowth. Animal trails, the occasional human track, and the distant sound of a stream.

Ridge Lookout.name: Ridge Lookout
Ridge Lookout.description: A rocky outcrop above the nest that offers a partial view of the surrounding woods and a distant smoke trail that might be a farmstead or small settlement.

tribe.name: Unnamed Nest

resources.food: low (a few days of scavenged meat and grain)
resources.weapons: crude clubs, a few scavenged knives and broken spears

tribe.territory: Small cave network under a wooded hillside in a remote frontier region

eventsLog: Campaign initialized. Ordinary adult male goblin begins in a small frontier nest under Grak the Split-Ear.

grak-split-ear.name: Grak the Split-Ear
grak-split-ear.description: Scarred older male goblin, larger and heavier than average. One ear is torn nearly in half. Rules the nest through strength and casual violence.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.description: One of Grak's favored warriors. Lean, mean, and quick with a scavenged spear.

grik.name: Grik
grik.description: Another of the stronger males who hangs near Grak. Broad-shouldered for a goblin and fond of bullying weaker nest-mates.

history: Turn 0: New Goblin Slayer campaign initialized. Player begins as an ordinary adult male goblin in a small, unremarkable frontier nest led by Grak the Split-Ear.
